title: Print before and after
prompt: The robot logs a value with a marker before and after it. Write `start`, which prints "start", and `finish`, which prints "done". In `solve`, call start, then print n, then call finish, so solve(7) prints start, 7, done.
hints: solve can mix its own prints with calls to helpers.
Three lines in solve, in the order the output should appear: `start()`, `print(n)`, `finish()`.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
